Full passenger cabin: FlyByWire's own detailed cabin (seats, suites, stairs, galleys) behind the cockpit door, with see-through passenger windows. It costs about 6-8 fps on our test machine
Displays start at a daylight brightness instead of 15 %: FlyByWire's automatic brightness now follows the sun, bright by day and dimmer at dusk and night
Screens have FlyByWire's LCD backlight glow, so their dark areas look lit from behind instead of printed black
Cockpit sounds no longer eat the frame rate: the sound engine went from about 80 ms to under 1 ms a frame
The installer can use 2048 px cockpit textures to save video memory
Wings droop on the ground instead of standing up in their flight shape, and the gaps between wing panels close
The IRs read 0 kt while parked instead of creeping up to 10-45 kt, and hold their heading after an engines-running start
Passenger windows are opaque, so you no longer see through the empty fuselage into the APU bay and tailcone
Moving to a new spot or airport rebuilds the systems with the gear down and locked
Engines keep their flame when the thrust levers come back to idle
The "two interior cockpit objects" warning on load is gone
EFIS ROSE and RANGE knobs turn, and the EFIS buttons light when on
Exterior lights switched off while the aircraft is unpowered stay off when power returns
Display breakers darken their screen, battery breakers disconnect their battery, and fire loop breakers show a loop fault instead of a false engine fire
Views and X-Plane keys work again after using the EFB; only its text fields take the keyboard
Presets never get stuck: a step that cannot finish gives up after a minute, and another preset replaces the running one
Reset aircraft state rebuilds the systems without restarting the displays
The passenger cabin switch says when the cabin is not part of your install
New Diagnostics tab: one-launch capture, photo tour, screen saves and a health check, saved as one bundle to attach to a bug report
EFIS buttons work: LS, VV, CSTR, WPT, VOR.D, NDB, ARPT, TAXI, WX, TERR, TRAF and the navaid selectors
ECAM control panel: CLR, RCL LAST, T.O CONFIG and ALL work, and the APU page opens by itself on APU start
EXT PWR pushbuttons switch ground power on and off line; a cold start leaves them off
The NDs are touch screens again (BTV and the other map functions)
Sidestick and speedbrake lever move with your inputs; elevators and ailerons move the right way
MFD pages are no longer cut off at the bottom
Airport map (OANS) from the AMDB Bridge, or downloaded from the Free Airport Mapping DB when the bridge is not running
Terrain on the ND gets the aircraft's position again
METAR and TAF work again: FlyByWire's weather service is blocked for many users, so they come from VATSIM or NOAA
Circuit breakers can be pulled and reset
Drop-down menus open, pages no longer jump around, and the Study pages are much lighter
Restart displays restarts every screen; Open logs and state dumps point at the right folders
Tabs keep their names readable and wrap onto a second row in a narrow window
Wings no longer sit flexed up on the ground: FlyByWire's flex model now gets each gear leg's real load from X-Plane
Pitch trim sign fixed: the controls no longer feel reversed
Wing flex follows the aircraft's real accelerations instead of going wild
Vertical fin at its real size (106 m², was 83): more yaw stability and rudder authority
New flights start with 97 t of fuel instead of full tanks over the maximum takeoff weight
Gear on the ground after a new start
APU bleed no longer turns itself on
QNH knobs turn, push and pull on both sides
Rudder trim, pitch trim and seat switches keep running while held
FlyByWire's own engine, APU and system sounds, placed around the aircraft
Reset aircraft state and new airframe
UTC and local clock, chrono and text size
Update check on the Status tab
Installer and updater that download from GitHub releases
FlyByWire's systems run in their own process, in lockstep with X-Plane's frame
Flight warning system clock fixed: FWS 1+2 FAULT clears after the self test
Ground power stays connected on a cold start
Every MSFS variable, event and runtime call FlyByWire uses is served or reported
Display brightness follows the knobs in linear light
Placard lettering without black boxes or shadows
Cold and dark apron start states from FlyByWire's own start steps
